Non-negative CP decomposition of a three-way tensor

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity_downstream.R
fit_nonnegative_cp.Rd

Multiplicative-update non-negative CANDECOMP/PARAFAC with random uniform initialisation. The relative error is checked every check_every iterations; the fit stops when it changes by less than tol.

Usage

fit_nonnegative_cp(
  y,
  rank,
  seed = 1L,
  max_iter = 50L,
  tol = 1e-04,
  check_every = 5L,
  epsilon = 1e-10
)

Arguments

y

Non-negative array with three dimensions and no NA.

rank

Number of components.

seed

Seed of the initialisation.

max_iter

Maximum number of iterations.

tol

Convergence tolerance.

check_every

Error-check interval.

epsilon

Lower bound of denominators.

Value

A list with unit-norm factor matrices A, B, C, lambda, error (relative), explained, iterations, converged, history and rank.
